- Adds `add-paper.md` and `survey-topic.md` (both routed via `/implement`, each with a swap-to-`/answer` hint and a definition of done)

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: e2a4ab7fec62e782cd555f29ccbd218a431cf46d -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #48 replaces inherited Quartz bug/feature templates with literature-specific GitHub issue templates. It adds prefilled Markdown dispatch templates for adding a paper and surveying a topic, plus `config.yml` with blank issues enabled and a README contact link. The PR follows the lean prefilled-Markdown convention described in the PR body: command first, guidance in comments, editable request body. The remaining concern is that the survey template’s definition of done is less complete than the add-paper template and the README navigation guidance.

## Review
The PR is well scoped and the reviewers agree on one non-blocking but actionable documentation gap. No meaningful reviewer disagreement was found.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Complete survey template definition of done | WARNING | [`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/survey-topic.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/e2a4ab7fec62e782cd555f29ccbd218a431cf46d/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/survey-topic.md#L10-L13) omits `_meta.json` manifest updates and `npm run check:site`, even though surveys add content under both `content/papers/` and `content/notes/`. |

## Progress
- Rubrics review passed overall and already identified the same survey-template manifest gap.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were fetched; none existed before this synthesis comment pass.
- Posted one inline comment on `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/survey-topic.md` line 13.
- No replies were added, no comments were minimized, and no review threads were resolved.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Complete survey template definition of done</summary>

**Cause:** The survey template stops at adding bibliography entries, paper notes, and a synthesis note. The README says content folders with Markdown should maintain `_meta.json` manifests, and this repo has both [`content/papers/_meta.json`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/e2a4ab7fec62e782cd555f29ccbd218a431cf46d/content/papers/_meta.json) and [`content/notes/_meta.json`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/e2a4ab7fec62e782cd555f29ccbd218a431cf46d/content/notes/_meta.json).

**Candidate solutions:** Extend the survey DoD to require new paper slugs in `content/papers/_meta.json`, the synthesis note slug in `content/notes/_meta.json`, and `npm run check:site` passing.

**Comments:** This mirrors the stronger DoD already used in `add-paper.md` and keeps generated survey PRs aligned with the README’s navigation-manifest contract.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The remaining issue is a small, deterministic template edit that is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Update `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/survey-topic.md` so its DoD requires `content/papers/_meta.json`, `content/notes/_meta.json`, and `npm run check:site`.
